profile_text.body:
CACI International is a public company founded in 1962, headquartered in Arlington County, and listed on the NYSE under the ticker CACI. According to its own site, it works on national security and government technology, describing itself as Ever Vigilant and saying it pushes the boundaries of the nation's capabilities as threats evolve. Its site highlights work in electronic warfare, counter-UAS, deep learning, and Agile DevSecOps, along with RF-based solutions it says draw on more than 20 years of experience and are modular, scalable, software-defined, battle-proven, rapidly deployable, and interoperable with existing C-UxS systems. It also describes modernizing end-to-end IT infrastructure from on-premises to cloud and edge, modernizing government applications and business processes using Agile methodologies and advanced analytics, and American-made optical communication, sensing, and processing technology for missions from the battlefield to deep space.

The site's news items include a first quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results release scheduled for Wednesday, October 21, a philanthropy program called Good Dogs for Great Americans launched September 24, 2026, a one-year plus four option periods award to support U.S. Central Command (USCENTCOM) and its mission partners, and the opening of the CACI Manufacturing Center of Excellence for Defense Electronics in the Greater Rochester, New York, area. It also references a 2019 Sea-Air-Space Exposition demonstration.

The company's SEC filing record lists CIK 0000016058. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
